gomarble.description: Hosted remote MCP server by GoMarble for paid media and marketing data. One OAuth connector for 400+ tools across Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, GA4, Search Console, Shopify and Klaviyo, with campaign changes made within the permissions you set. Requires a GoMarble account; sign in through the MCP client's OAuth flow. Docs: https://www.gomarble.ai/mcp
